summary: 1937 CCC-built 120-foot Aermotor fire tower near Disputanta, Prince George County, Virginia; NHLR-registered 2003; inactive per NHLR, still listed standing. Access unknown.

facts.design: 120-foot Aermotor tower with 7 by 7 foot metal cab
facts.status_note: NHLR says the tower is now inactive; the Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia list still shows it standing

access.note: No source read says whether the public may visit or climb the tower.

events.note: Constructed by the Civilian Conservation Corps for the Virginia Department of Forestry; NHLR prints the year as l937
Announced July 19, 1953 as going into operation that day because of dry timberlands; first summer manning since organization, per the Progress-Index as quoted by Forest Lookouts
Registered April 25, 2003 as US 511, VA 7; nominated by Christopher B. Hargrave, Virginia Registrar

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the tower is now inactive; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list still shows it standing. Both can be true of a structure still up but no longer in use. The record keeps status standing with a status_note.

The Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives the alias Disputanta (Prince George) with the same registry number, US 511, VA 7, and the 1953 item calls the tower near Disputanta. Treated as one tower.

notes_for_editor: Two registry sources and one 1953 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts; the newspaper itself was not read. No source read covers fires the tower spotted, staffing after 1953, or current access. NHLR prints the build year as l937 with a lowercase L; recorded as 1937. The brief coordinates (37.18222, -77.2) are the NHLR figures; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list places the tower about 1 km west, at 37.18149, -77.21294. The record keeps NHLR's coordinates. The brief record checks out (elevation 44.8 m matches 147 ft); its status 'standing' stands with the NHLR inactive note added. Encyclopedia Virginia's essay on CCC work in Prince George County was checked and does not mention this tower, so it is not cited. No new photos. Not verified: current condition beyond the standing listing.
